LightningComponentBundle.description: Split screen with a resizable divider: file preview (PDF, JPG, PNG, GIF) on the left, editable JSON form on the right.

property.name: contentDocumentId
property.label: Content Document Id
property.description: Id of the file (ContentDocument) to preview.

property.name: jsonInput
property.label: Source JSON
property.description: The JSON string to render as an editable form.

property.name: height
property.label: Height
property.description: CSS height of the component, e.g. 600px or 70vh.

property.name: submitLabel
property.label: Save Button Label
property.description: Label of the button that returns the modified JSON.

property.name: editLabels
property.label: Allow field names to be edited
property.description: When off, field names render as plain text and only the values can be edited.

property.name: editStructure
property.label: Allow fields to be added and deleted
property.description: When on, the reviewer can add fields, list items and groups, and delete any of them. Adding under a field that holds a value turns it into a group or list.

property.name: collapsible
property.label: Allow groups to be collapsed
property.description: When on, groups and lists get an expand/collapse chevron plus Expand all and Collapse all buttons.

property.name: searchable
property.label: Show a search box
property.description: When on, a search box filters the form by field name or value, keeping matches in the context of their parent groups.

property.name: showConfidence
property.label: Show extraction confidence
property.description: When on, {value, confidence} envelopes are unwrapped so the field shows its value, with the confidence as a badge. The envelope is restored in the output JSON.

property.name: confidenceThreshold
property.label: Low confidence below
property.description: Confidence under which the badge turns red. Accepts a fraction (0.8) or a percentage (80). Only used when Show extraction confidence is on.

property.name: validateTypes
property.label: Flag values of the wrong type
property.description: When on, a value that no longer parses as the type it was loaded as is outlined in red, and Save stays disabled until it is corrected.

property.name: mappingSetName
property.label: Mapping Set for Preview
property.description: DeveloperName of the IDP_Mapping_Set__mdt to preview against. Leave blank to hide the Preview button and never call the mapping engine.

property.name: jsonOutput
property.label: Modified JSON
property.description: The JSON string including the user's edits.
